question: On the accepted one-aircraft cross-midnight B04 turnround model, does shortening only MissionTurnround.DURN from 1 to 0.75 hour free the aircraft at h24.25, allow its serial 0.5-hour preparation to finish exactly at the h24.75 scheduled second launch, and avoid the accepted parent's h25 delay?

accepted_parent.accepted_behavior: same physical aircraft completes first mission h21.5-23.5; one-hour turnround h23.5-24.5 delays second 0.5-hour preparation to h24.5-25 and second launch to h25, with h27 return and h27-28 turnround; the no-turnround control launches second mission at h24.75. Both accepted runs have 12 sealed local raw files.

instructional_prerequisites.B02: published B02 1.0.2 fixed serial preparation is the accepted B04 source parent
instructional_prerequisites.A02: published A02 repeated-mission behavior is an accepted B04 prerequisite

manual.interpretation: After return a system remains associated with its mission until turnround completes; MissionTurnround.DURN is mandatory calendar time for the task, overridden only by subtasks. This model has no turnround subtasks or resource demand. The manual does not establish the exact h24.25 release-to-preparation or h24.75 launch event order, which is the native question.

source_delta.only_changed_cell: MissionTurnround row0 DURN 1.0 to 0.75 hour among 204 authored cells
source_delta.retained: two scheduled waves h21.5 and h24.75, one-hour second-wave delay allowance, two serial preparation subtasks totaling 0.5 hour, one aircraft, seed/horizon36, collection interval0.5, and all other authored cells

predeclared_acceptance: Independent contract review must pin accepted B04 source, signoff, diff, both closures and all 24 local raw files, plus accepted B02/A02 behavior; no accepted native run may be repeated.

Freeze exact one-cell positional parent diff, negative control from accepted h24.5 release and h25 launch, exact populated-table roundtrip checker, complete behavior validator and unique SSH0 runner. Require independent static prelaunch GO bound to exact SHA before native.

Require actual SSH0/sshd ancestry, free Global\SimloxIssue18NativeQueue, absent unique run directory, only protected responding GUI PID/session/start, stable source SHA before/after and preserved failure bytes.

Import/export must retain only MissionTurnround.DURN0.75 and all authored populated tables. Converter errors zero and warnings classified are mandatory; rejection or missing report is NO_GO and proves no physical behavior.

For valid calculation require first mission/return at h21.5-23.5, first turnround h23.5-24.25 across midnight, second notice h23.75, physical aircraft0 allocation/preparation start h24.25 and end h24.75 before scheduled h24.75 launch, success/return h26.75 and second turnround h26.75-27.5. No mission cancellation, delay or other aircraft. Exact same-time event order is observational for this source only.

Require complete 72x40 System, 72x16 Stock, 11 ResultSummary and ProblemDescription fields. Independently derive each half-hour System ledger, including fractional occupation bins from h24.25, h24.75, h26.75 and h27.5; Stock, summary, first mission and stable columns must match accepted B04, and terminal aircraft ready. Unexpected output is NO_GO with no postrun relaxation.

Require separately authored read-only replay of every source/raw SHA and size, event identity/order and report field, bounded signoff, independent staged and remote review, and authorized simlox/main PR/merge.
limits: One seed, aircraft, two fixed waves and one turnround duration only; this does not establish general same-time priority, resource-constrained turnround, repair, other missions or B04 in full.
